files.description: Workbook rendered by the online leaderboard

Main benchmark treatment decision: reasoning, corresponding (node accuracy), staging, indication/contraindication, treatment (NDCG for oncology, set-F1 for ACS/AIS), calibration ECEs; ITT (paper) and parse-valid subset
Case-level bootstrap 95% CIs (B=1000, seed 628) for reasoning, treatment and ECE
Cross-cohort (5-cohort) mean reasoning score with bootstrap 95% CI

Survival prediction C-index on the cohort roster (parse-valid, zero follow-up excluded), bootstrap 95% CI (B=500, seed 628). For ACS/AIS the paper's primary survival endpoint is 12-month mortality (see survival_12m_mortality_acute.csv)
ACS/AIS 12-month mortality AUROC/AUPRC (autonomous and treatment-conditioned) with bootstrap CIs

Survival confidence risk-coverage scalars (AURC, selective gain at 50%/20% coverage, Spearman rho), mean over 30 random orders of equal-confidence cases (BCLC, CNLC, NSCLC, ACS; AIS uses 12-month mortality)
Single-centre HCC cohort (n=443; 10 LLMs + OpenEvidence) x treatment / treatment-conditioned survival / autonomous survival. Separate cohort; not comparable to the main-benchmark leaderboard
Clinician vs model on the same matched subsets (REAL20 single-centre HCC; SEER CNLC 40). Not comparable to full-cohort scores
Sensitivity: clinician 3 REAL20 reasoning after supplementing omitted objective tags (v1 is the formal value)
CNLC SFT ablation (6 models x zero-shot / guideline injection / SFT / knowledge-augmented SFT; n=1050 each) with bootstrap 95% CIs (B=1000, seed 628)
Figure 1e radar axes (cross-cohort means; ECE as 1-ECE; Average = mean of the 8 axes)
Figure 2b-3 / Supplementary Fig. S4 panels: stage-stratified IPCW-MAE and censored MAE (parse-valid cases with known stage)
Supplementary Fig. S5: stage-stratified mean signed residual (predicted - true survival, months); stages shown in the figure require n >= 20 for every model
